title: A semio.infer Pump crossing keeps driving its mounted session until the host's crossing grant is spent
rootCause: Pump advanced exactly one mounted-session transition per step-job crossing and retired its outcome in a second crossing, so the WFC bitmap solve paid two host relay round trips for every 16-unit preview: the artifact_create genesis solve (16x16, N=3, sym 8, 24x24) settles natively in 16.6 s but crossed 541650 times in 582 s over the semio MCP without finishing.
